input-field.name: apiKey
input-field.label: API key
input-field.helpText: ArionPay dashboard > your store > API key (starts with pk_).

input-field.name: apiSecret
input-field.label: API secret
input-field.helpText: ArionPay dashboard > your store > API secret (starts with sk_).

input-field.name: webhookSecret
input-field.label: Webhook signing secret
input-field.helpText: ArionPay dashboard > Webhooks > signing secret (starts with whsec_). Nothing to paste into ArionPay: every invoice tells ArionPay where to send its updates.

input-field.name: testMode
input-field.label: Test mode
input-field.helpText: Test invoices: no real money moves. Turn it off before you take real payments.

input-field.name: baseUrl
input-field.label: ArionPay address
input-field.helpText: Leave empty unless ArionPay tells you otherwise.
